indicators.description: Hard-currency bonds trading at deeply distressed prices
Government has tabled a debt-restructuring proposal to creditors

onset.summary: Argentine hard-currency bonds trade at deeply distressed prices and the government has put a restructuring proposal to creditors while an interest payment sits inside its grace period. Reserves are thin, the economy is contracting into the pandemic, and negotiations with large bondholders are unresolved.

source_refs.title: Argentina: Staff Technical Note on Public Debt Sustainability (IMF Country Report No. 20/83, March 2020)

indicators.description: Commodity terms of trade falling steeply from their peak
World merchandise trade volumes contracting quarter on quarter

onset.summary: World trade and commodity prices are contracting sharply and every large advanced economy is shrinking. Australia is a commodity exporter heavily exposed to external demand, its currency and terms of trade have dropped, and forecasters widely expect its output to turn negative for consecutive quarters.

source_refs.title: Australia: 2010 Article IV Consultation Staff Report (IMF Country Report No. 10/331)
BIS 79th Annual Report (2008/09)

indicators.description: Mortgage inventory financed overnight in tri-party repo
Broker-dealer without access to the central-bank discount window
Three-month interbank spreads over overnight index swaps remain wide

onset.summary: The smallest of the US independent investment banks is denying market rumours about its liquidity. It finances a large book of mortgage-related securities overnight in tri-party repo, so its funding must be renewed each morning by lenders who are themselves under redemption pressure, and it has no access to the central-bank discount window.

indicators.description: Mass rating downgrades of US subprime asset-backed paper
Asset-backed commercial paper conduits unable to roll maturing paper
A peer institution has required support over similar structured exposures

onset.summary: A large French bank is preparing to suspend subscriptions and redemptions in three funds exposed to US subprime-linked asset-backed securities because liquidity in those segments has evaporated and the assets can no longer be valued. Rating agencies have downgraded swathes of subprime paper, asset-backed commercial paper conduits cannot roll maturing notes, and a German lender has already needed rescue over similar exposures.

Credit rating cut toward the low end of investment grade

Its credit rating has been cut toward the bottom of investment grade, its shares have fallen steeply, and it is weighing whether to seek federal support.

Bank funds part of its balance sheet in wholesale markets

Shares fell sharply in the renewed regional-bank sell-off

onset.summary: A second wave of the regional-bank sell-off has hit mid-size commercial lenders after another bank was seized earlier in the week, with investors again focused on uninsured deposits and unrealised securities losses. This bank's shares dropped sharply and it is watching deposit trends closely.

indicators.description: Largest shareholder publicly rules out further capital
Credit-default-swap spreads at distressed levels
Client asset outflows in the preceding quarter

onset.summary: A globally systemic Swiss bank's largest shareholder has publicly ruled out putting in more capital, a day after the annual report disclosed material weaknesses in financial-reporting controls. Its credit-default swaps trade at distressed levels and its shares are at a record low; it lost more than 100 billion Swiss francs of client money in the prior quarter, and wealth clients can move balances in a day.

indicators.description: Share of deposits above the insurance cap
Eleven large banks placing a 30 billion dollar deposit to steady it
Assets dominated by low-rate jumbo mortgages and municipal bonds

onset.summary: A private-banking-focused lender with wealthy coastal clients is losing deposits fast as savers compare it with a bank closed days earlier. Roughly two-thirds of its deposits exceed the insurance cap and its assets are long-dated low-rate jumbo mortgages and municipal bonds worth far less than carrying value; eleven large banks are placing an uninsured deposit with it to steady confidence.

The group has missed lease payments under those financings and is in forbearance talks with lenders, with a heavy debt load and thin liquidity.

indicators.description: Funding dominated by wholesale and securitisation markets rather than retail deposits
Emergency liquidity support requested from the central bank
Residential mortgage securitisation issuance closed since August

onset.summary: A fast-growing British mortgage lender that funds a prime loan book mainly through securitisation and wholesale money markets rather than retail deposits has approached the central bank for emergency liquidity support after wholesale issuance closed. National deposit insurance covers only part of an ordinary balance, giving savers a reason to withdraw, and queues have formed at branches.

indicators.description: Fund holds commercial paper of a broker-dealer now under court protection
Shares carry no insurance despite being used as a cash equivalent
Institutional prime money-fund redemption requests surging

onset.summary: The oldest US money-market fund holds several hundred million dollars of a large broker-dealer's commercial paper whose issuer has just entered court protection. Investors treat these funds as cash redeemable at par with no insurance behind them, institutional redemption requests are arriving within hours, and prime funds are hoarding cash rather than rolling commercial paper.

onset.summary: A New York commercial bank with a large digital-asset client base is facing heavy withdrawal requests on the day a technology-focused peer is closed. Its deposits are also mostly above the insurance cap, its funding is concentrated in a client sector already stressed by a crypto-market downturn, and withdrawal requests are continuing over the weekend.

indicators.description: Share of deposits above the insurance cap
Loss realised selling the available-for-sale portfolio to raise cash
Large unrealised loss on the held-to-maturity securities book

onset.summary: A mid-size bank whose depositors are almost entirely venture-backed technology companies has announced after the close that it sold its available-for-sale securities at a 1.8 billion dollar loss and will raise equity to fill the gap. About 94 percent of its deposits sit above the insurance cap, its held-to-maturity book carries large unrealised losses after sharp policy tightening, and its depositors are concentrated and can move online within the hour.

Unemployment rate rising rapidly as construction contracts

indicators.description: Bid-offer spreads on long-dated government bonds remain above pre-stress norms though off their peak
Primary-dealer balance-sheet capacity to absorb government bonds remains stretched relative to demand
Central-bank large-scale purchases remain the marginal buyer stabilising the market

onset.summary: Emergency official purchases have pulled the government-bond market back from the seizure of mid-March, but conditions remain fragile. Bid-offer spreads on long-dated bonds, though well below their peak, are still wider than pre-stress norms, primary dealers' capacity to warehouse inventory is stretched against continued selling by foreign holders and levered funds, and the central bank is the marginal buyer holding the market together. The alert is whether disorderly trading returns once official support is scaled back.

source_refs.title: BIS Bulletin No. 2: The recent distress in corporate bond markets and the March 2020 turmoil

A downgrade would trigger additional collateral demands

Breach of the asset-based revolving credit facility

It has defaulted under its asset-based credit facility, its vendors are tightening terms, and its shares and bonds trade at deeply distressed levels.

onset.summary: An online used-car retailer is deeply unprofitable, carrying a heavy debt load taken on during the boom while used-car prices fall and higher rates raise its financing costs. Its bonds trade at distressed prices and creditors have organised, with market commentary questioning whether it can avoid court protection.

Industrial regions shut for containment

onset.summary: China locked down its industrial regions to contain the outbreak, and activity indicators for the first quarter have dropped to unprecedented lows as factories and transport halted. Global demand is now falling too, and a full-year contraction is widely expected.

Cash burn running at tens of millions of dollars per day

onset.summary: Air travel has fallen by the vast majority of normal volumes and a large network carrier is burning tens of millions of dollars in cash a day with aircraft parked. Its shares have dropped steeply and forecasts see demand depressed for a long period.

Banks limiting hard-currency withdrawals and transfers

onset.summary: Lebanon's foreign reserves have fallen steeply, banks have imposed informal limits on withdrawals and transfers since late 2019, and the currency is trading far weaker than its official peg on a parallel market.
